videos.headline: Umesh Yadav to Anderson, out Caught by Pant!! India conquer London again in this series to go 2-1! Umesh with the finishing touches to a famous win. Short of a length outside off, Anderson goes fishing and gets a thin edge through to Pant. The Indians knew it straightaway and so did the ump but Anderson signalled for the review straightaway. Not sure why, maybe just to have some fun of his own. UltraEdge shows a spike and the celebrations start in the visitors' camp. Anderson c Pant b Umesh Yadav 2(5)

Umesh Yadav to Craig Overton, out Bowled!! Beaten for pace and Overton is in pain!! Not only does he have to make the walk back but this could well be a crucial injury with the next Test not that far away. Sharp outswinger from Umesh, lands on middle-and-off and squares up Overton completely, striking him on the back arm and the ball deflects onto the stumps. A freak area to get injured and Overton is wincing as he goes back. He's definitely in severe pain. India on the brink now. Craig Overton b Umesh Yadav 10(29) [4s-1]

Umesh Yadav to Woakes, out Caught by Rahul!! The trap has worked and India have their 8th wicket - this was full and at the pads, Woakes shuffled across on the flick, fell over slightly and overbalanced on the shot, couldn't keep it down and KL does the rest, diving forward and snaffling it, inches above the turf. The players will walk off for tea with India two wickets away from going 2-1 up. Woakes c Rahul b Umesh Yadav 18(47) [4s-1]

Thakur to Root, out Bowled!! Shardul and his magic spells - he has the knack of taking the big wickets in these games, he's got rid of the one man who could have defied India today. Is that the match for India? Root is disgusted as he walks away - Kohli didn't take the new ball, brought Shardul on for a spell and he strikes gold for his captain. Look at him running around in joy - short of a good length and holding its line outside off, Root was looking to play the steer backward of point, it's a shot that has got him plenty of runs this season - unluckily for him, he only manages an inside edge and the ball ricochets onto his stumps. Was playing with an angled bat, was perhaps looking to work it very square. Root b Thakur 36(78) [4s-3]

Jadeja to Moeen Ali, out Caught by (sub)Suryakumar Yadav!! Jadeja strikes again! What an exceptional passage of play this is for the visitors! The morning session suggested a hard grind for them but Bumrah and Jadeja have made a mockery of things in these 40 minutes after lunch. This is another classical Jadeja dismissal, aiming for the rough and with the left-hander on strike, it's more trickier than it would have been for the right-hander. Moeen plays a nothing shot, pushing aimlessly at one that spins big off the rough, catching the inside edge and straight to Surya at short leg. This is some implosion from England. Moeen Ali c (sub)Suryakumar Yadav b Jadeja 0(4)

Bumrah to Bairstow, out Bowled!! The Bumrah masterclass is on! In just about 30 minutes, this game has taken a massive turn towards the visitors. Another peach from India's pace spearhead, his patented yorker that tails in sharply at good pace. Maybe Bairstow wasn't expecting it or even if he was, couldn't react in time. Timber! Half the side down now and it does seem like the countdown has begun. Bairstow b Bumrah 0(4)

Bumrah to Ollie Pope, out Bowled!! Knocked him over! It's Bumrah's 100th Test wicket as well! England's first-innings hero is sent back cheaply and it seems like the visitors' march is on with these early strikes in the session. Classic set up this, kept straightening the in-anglers constantly and then bowled the inswinger that totally caught Pope by surprise. Overbalanced on the shuffle and totally played down the wrong line. The Indians are buoyant and are smelling blood now. Ollie Pope b Bumrah 2(11)

Jadeja to Haseeb Hameed, out Bowled!! Jadeja gets a cracker out of the rough! This is what he had been trying to do all innings but Hameed had been dealing it well, either covering the line well or padding it away. This time, he isn't quite to the pitch of this slider that lands on the rough outside leg and rips away, past the tentative poke and disturbes off stump. Perfect start for India after the break. This dismissal also explains why Root is keen on that reverse sweep, he doesn't want Jadeja to exploit that to him. Haseeb Hameed b Jadeja 63(193) [4s-6]

Jadeja to Haseeb Hameed, out Malan Run Out!! Huge roar in the Indian camp, as Malan has been run-out. That's what pressure does folks! Was no need to take this run, indeed. Hameed the man guillty as he pushes this in front of cover-point and calls for a quick run. The fielder stationed there sprints across, collects the ball and fires in a throw at Pant's end. The keeper keeps his cool, collects the ball right above the stumps and takes down the bails before Malan could get in with his full stretched dive. The Indian fans in the stadium have gone in a state of euphoria following Malan's dismissal. Superb fiellding there by Mayank Agarwal. What a moment! Plenty of flags in the stands, cheering the visiting team. Malan run out (Mayank/Pant) 5(33)

Thakur to Rory Burns, out Caught by Pant!! An absolute jaffa and India celebrate. Fifty and OUT for Burns, but he couldn't have done anything about this - In his first over and Shardul has broken through for the visitors, pitched up in that channel around off, came back with the angle and then straightens with the seam - Burns had to play, he didn't do anything wrong, looked to defend with the straight bat, but the ball caught the edge and Pant does the rest. India were looking a bit down, but this should lift them immensely. Rory Burns c Pant b Thakur 50(125) [4s-5]

Moeen Ali to Pant, out Caught&Bowled!! Pant is livid with himself! He almost doesn't want to walk off the pitch. Stepped out to play the big shot, wanted to go over the bowler's head but didn't get the desired elevation at all. Ended up slapping it straight back at Moeen who reacted sharply to take the return catch. Was hit quite hard, so definitely wasn't that easy a catch. Double strike for England and they will be feeling better than they were five minutes ago. Pant c and b Moeen Ali 50(106) [4s-4]

Root to Thakur, out Caught by Craig Overton!! Edged and taken! The change in bowling works and England have finally broken through this partnership. The non-turner from Root, Thakur expects it to turn a bit and as a result, the drive ends up being a regulation edge for first slip. Thakur is livid with himself, he was batting with total control and would have wanted to get more. He's still done a phenomenal job though. Came in when India were in slightly tricky waters and has now put the visitors in a position of relative safety. Thakur c Craig Overton b Root 60(72) [4s-7 6s-1]

Moeen Ali to Kohli, out Caught by Craig Overton!! Massive moment in the match, is it the clincher for England? Kohli looks gutted, but has to walk back to the pavilion. It's turning out to be a fine morning for the hosts - India's lead is still only 213 and one end has been opened up. Nicely bowled by Moeen, this was the drifter outside off, kept going straight with the angle, Kohli was playing for the turn as he pushed forward, the ball found the edge and it's a simple catch for Overton at slip. Root might not have bargained for Kohli's wicket when he brought on Moeen, but has turned into a masterstroke. Perhaps Kohli could have played with a straight bat, but he was playing with a slightly open face. Kohli c Craig Overton b Moeen Ali 44(96) [4s-7]

Woakes to Rahane, out Lbw!! Woakes strikes again! Out of nowhere, he has brought England right back into this game. Fullish inswinger, attacking the stumps and Rahane plays around the wrong line, missing it completely to be struck low on the front pad. Looked stone dead in real time and this time, not just the ump but Kohli also knew it at the other end. Suggested Rahane not to review it. Another failure for the vice-captain and India are suddenly in a bit of bother here. Rahane lbw b Woakes 0(8)

Woakes to Jadeja, out Lbw!! Not the first time that Woakes has broken a threatening partnership in this game! Makes you wonder why he didn't start off from one end, given where the match was poised overnight. Anyways, this is a lovely nip-backer, pitched around off and lured Jadeja forward but he didn't cover for the inward movement as much. Struck just below the knee roll and it looked out in real time. Easy call for the ump. Jadeja reviews it to test out his luck but HawkEye sends him packing with Three Reds. Some respite for the hosts because it was just seeming like India were getting away from them. Jadeja lbw b Woakes 17(59) [4s-3]

Robinson to Pujara, out Caught by Moeen Ali!! What a fantastic over by Robinson. He has taken two wickets in the first over with the new ball. Bangs this short on middle and the ball seams in off the deck. Pujara looks to defend it and ends up getting an inside edge that thuds into the thigh and lobs towards Moeen at third slip. Robinson runs with his arms wide open! Pujara c Moeen Ali b Robinson 61(127) [4s-9]

Robinson to Rohit, out Caught by Woakes!! New ball does the trick for England! And once again it's that instinctive pull shot that results in Rohit's downfall. Was a really short ball but it arrived it a little late than Rohit anticipated. Goes for a pull, gets the timing completely long. Miscues it, probably of the cue end and Woakes at deep square leg takes a decent catch as he ambles towards his left. Walks back to a standing ovation does the Indian opener and he deserves every bit of it. Rohit c Woakes b Robinson 127(256) [4s-14 6s-1]

Anderson to Rahul, out Caught by Bairstow!! England review: Anderson thinks KL Rahul is caught behind, but the on-field umpire doesn't think so. However, there's a huge spike on UltraEdge and KL Rahul has to depart. Huge roar by the English supporters as soon as they see it on the big screen. And a disappointed KL starts to walk back to the pavilion. England were confident the batsman had nicked it, and UltraEdge confirms the same. Just the wicket they were in search of and Rahul misses out on his fifty as well. Good knock nevertheless as the deficit is down to 16 runs. Was a short of a length delivery that seamed away to take the outside edge. KL wasn't happy with the decision, he seemed to be suggesting that the bat hit the pad, it did hit his pad, but not when the UltraEdge showed the spike. Quality stuff by England's ace bowler. Rahul c Bairstow b Anderson 46(101) [4s-6 6s-1]

Thakur to Ollie Pope, out Bowled!! That's the big wicket and Ollie Pope hits the ground with his bat in frustration. Was playing so well till now, but he tries to chase a widish one and has played it onto his stumps. Indian fans have found their voice back as Shardul breaks the stand. Just the wicket India were in search of. Good knock by Ollie, nevertheless. Came in when England were struggling at 62/5 and walks back after playing a crucial knock of 81, giving England a considerable lead and a lot to cheer about. Ollie Pope b Thakur 81(159) [4s-6]

Jadeja to Moeen Ali, out Caught by Rohit!! Not sure what the discussion was, but Moeen has done a Pant here - once again Moeen gets a start, looks attractive and finds the softest possible way to get himself dismissed. Nicely flighted and wide of off, Moeen was looking for the big swipe over the on-side - went too hard on the shot, lost his poise and his balance in doing so, skewed off the thick top-edge and it's a straightforward catch to Rohit, at cover. Much needed wicket for India, the shoulders were beginning to droop. And yes, Jadeja has got rid of a left-handed batsman. Moeen Ali c Rohit b Jadeja 35(71) [4s-7]

Siraj to Bairstow, out Lbw!! Siraj has broken through! Just when it seemed like nothing was threatening the batters, he produces a cracking nip-backer and Bairstow has always been susceptible to the incoming delivery. Plays around the wrong line and gets struck on the front pad. Looked gone in real time and the ump too raised his finger instantly. Only the bounce in The Oval surface could have saved Bairstow once he opted for the review but this is full enough to send him packing. Three Reds on HawkEye. Relief among the Indians as the partnership has finally been broken. Bairstow lbw b Siraj 37(77) [4s-7]

Umesh Yadav to Malan, out Caught by Rohit!! The birthday boy is gone! And that's a superb catch by Rohit at second slip as he dives to his right. So the two changes made by India in this match, both of them have impressed. Any more questions? That's a good length delivery by Umesh Yadav outside off that swings in to an extent and Malan feels for it. A regulation outside edge towards Rohit at second slip and the Hitman completes a lovely catch, I would like to reiterate. England are five down with only 62 on the board. Turning out to be a blockbuster, this contest. Malan c Rohit b Umesh Yadav 31(67) [4s-5]

Umesh Yadav to Craig Overton, out Caught by Kohli!! The nightwatchman is gone! Sharp catch by Kohli at first slip as Umesh Yadav strikes in his first over. England are four down. Yet another outswinger by Umesh Yadav, very close to the off-stump, Craig Overton goes for a cut off his back foot and gets a regulation outside edge that has been taken by the Indian skipper in the cordon. Impressive stuff by Umesh this. Got Root last evening, and strikes early in the morning session. Craig Overton c Kohli b Umesh Yadav 1(12)

Umesh Yadav to Root, out Bowled!! That's a huge, huge wicket! Umesh gets the man in form, it's the English skipper who departs at the stroke of stumps. Just 10 minutes to go and Root has been cleaned up. A superb delivery that by Umesh though. Back of a length around off and it comes in with the angle to breach Root's defence. Hits the top of off-stump and Umesh is pumped up as he jumps and punches the air in euphoria. That wicket will make India feel a lot better. Root b Umesh Yadav 21(25) [4s-4]

Bumrah to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Pant!! Bumrah takes his second wicket of the over and he's on fire with the new ball. That's a duck for Haseeb Hameed! Short ball outside off, Haseeb Hameed looks to ride the bounce with a flash and gets a thick outside edge. Pant takes a sharp catch to his right and both the English openers are back to the pavilion early. Bumrah is only one wicket away from completing 100 wickets in Test cricket. If he continues bowling in this way, he'll soon bag his 100th scalp as well. That's not going to be easy though as Root is in the form of his life. Haseeb Hameed c Pant b Bumrah 0(12)

Bumrah to Rory Burns, out Bowled!! Chopped on! Look at that death stare by Bumrah. He means business! Hits this on back of a length and it's a skiddy delivery once again. Rory Burns looks to defend it off his back foot and plays it onto the stumps. Could have got out in a similar fashion on the previous ball, but Burns survived. Not this time though! After a decent outing in the previous match, Burns falls for another cheap score. Rory Burns b Bumrah 5(11)

Woakes to Thakur, out Lbw!! Loud shout for LBW and England want a review. The height is an issue, did the ball graze the inside edge? No bat and UltraEdge confirms it. It's hitting the top of leg, three reds and Shardul is OUT. RElief for England, relief for Woakes and Shardul's slogfest comes to an end. But this has been a highly impactful innings - on a good length and slanting back into the right-hander, Shardul was looking to slug it over mid-wicket, gets beaten on the inside edge and is struck on the back-thigh, which was slightly bent, was playing the shot with a slightly crouched movement as well. It meant height wasn't an issue, enough to overturn the original NOT OUT call. Thakur lbw b Woakes 57(36) [4s-7 6s-3]

Woakes to Pant, out Caught by Moeen Ali!! Oh dear! This is a shocker, appalling cricket from Pant - pretty sure the dressing room will not be that welcoming after all. India in dire straits and he just can't be playing such atrocious shots. There's a way to counter-punch, but this is definitely not written in any manual. Runs down the pitch in a pre-meditated manner, Woakes saw it coming and cleverly pushed it wide - Pant could still have let it go, but he's committed at having a swipe, gets it right off the toe-end and lobs a simple catch to Moeen, jogging back from mid-off. That reprieve didn't cost England one bit. Was the slower off-break from Woakes, rolled his fingers across the seam. Pant c Moeen Ali b Woakes 9(33) [4s-1]

Craig Overton to Rahane, out Caught by Moeen Ali!! Edged and taken! Rahane's defiance has been ended and he'll be disappointed with this dismissal. It's been a pattern for him and he's once again nicked one through to the slip cordon. He had been leaving them fairly well until this point. Perhaps, those two short balls had a say in this. Maybe, he was expecting another one. We'll never know. Anyways, it's that probing line around the off stump with a hint of shape away, fuller length and Rahane's feet go nowhere as he goes fishing at this. Edges it to Moeen who takes a sharp low grab at third slip. It did momentarily pop out of his hand but he held onto it with the rebound. The third ump is consulted for the fair catch but he's just about held onto it. Rahane c Moeen Ali b Craig Overton 14(47) [4s-1]

Woakes to Jadeja, out Caught by Root!! Edged and taken! So the ploy to send Jadeja up the order hasn't worked. Never looked comfortable out in the middle and has perished early. Root takes it comfortably at first slip and gets a hug from Bairstow. Was on a shortish length outside off and the batsman played away from his body, only to get a regulation outside edge. Dropped Kohli a couple of overs ago, but makes sure to cling on to the catch this time around. India in trouble as they are four down. And the English fans in the stands are absolutely loving it. Jadeja c Root b Woakes 10(34) [4s-2]

Anderson to Pujara, out Caught by Bairstow!! Edged and caught! Pujara has a look at his partner and then walks off - there was a healthy edge on that, no need to think about a review. India in familiar choppy waters once again - the awayswinger from Anderson, pitched around off and jagged away sharply. Until now, Pujara was happy to play close to his body, but he went feeling for this one. No intent and no confidence behind the defensive prod, the ball takes the edge on its way to the keeper. Root's decision to bowl first on a cloudy morning is being vindicated by his bowlers. Pujara c Bairstow b Anderson 4(31) [4s-1]

Robinson to Rahul, out Lbw!! A celebappeal and Rahul has been given OUT LBW, He has a chat with his partner and decides to review. Was the impact outside off? Or is it a tad too high? No bat and UltraEdge confirms it. Onto ball-tracking, it's hitting the top of middle, India lose a second wicket at 28. The nip-backer from Robinson, pitched just outside off and seamed back in with the angle - Rahul was caught on the shuffle, beaten on the inside edge and is struck high on the back-pad, the impact was in front of off and it was going on to clip the top of off-stump. KL can consider himself a tad unlucky, only Robinson seemed convinced, none in the cordon went up, but most importantly, umpire Richard Illingworth felt it was good, and replays did vindicate him. Rahul lbw b Robinson 17(44) [4s-3]

Woakes to Rohit, out Caught by Bairstow!! Woakes with another cracker! First over of his comeback Test match and he produces a beautiful nut to get rid of Rohit. This really carried off the deck, moved sharply away from the right-hander too and the tight line meant that Rohit had to play at it. Thick edge and comfortably taken by Bairstow moving across to his right. England have broken through after a sedate start. Rohit c Bairstow b Woakes 11(27) [4s-1]
